name: real-app-burst
_comment: Join storm on FrameConsole (--host <sender IP>): every stage starts from zero (the runner waits until /api/stats reports the sessions of before the run), all viewers of the stage are requested at once and sent with 32 add requests in flight; first media counts from the burst start, so the queue behind the 32 is included. Hold 30 s. Traffic cap 30 GB covers the planned stages (~11 GB at 8.6 Mbit/s); the stop rules end the run past this PC's limit.
